comment: The DPI-H approach in general and the section on modularity imply that a single development trajectory can overcome the need to deliver solutions now while building the long term sustainable architecture the DPI-H approach aims for

anchor.note: p.33 l.286-301 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The DPI-H approach in general and the section on modularity imply that a single development trajectory can overcome the need to deliver solutions now while building the long term sustainable architecture the DPI-H approach aims for
public.suggestedRevision: Modularity can produce the same vertical type design or simply prove to difficult while trying to deliver without emphasising this risk or the (potential) need for parallel development approaches where the ideal/theoretical can be both conceived/developed and inform the immediate operational delivery. The first line (286) also defaults to recommending relying on any installed base (even at DPI-H or architectural level) which carries the same risk.
